subject: D-RUG tomorrow: Chris Hamm on phylogenetic analysis in R

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: D-RUG tomorrow: Chris Hamm on phylogenetic analysis in R
parts:
Hi all,

Tomorrow at D-RUG we'll have a talk by Chris Hamm, a postdoc in the Begun lab in EVE, on how he uses R to do phylogenetic analysis.  From Crhis:

I will be discussing a project that used the comparative method to examine patterns of butterfly diversification relative to feeding habitats (specialist vs. generalist). This is work in progress but we are close to submitting the work.  I’ll be presenting data that have primarily been generated using the iteRates, diversitree and turboMEDUSA packages.

Chris will talk at 3:10, and we'll have our regular co-work/Q&A afterwards.  As always, I'll bring cookies.

Best,

Noam
